gaps_limitations.gap: Fixed recall and cost thresholds may not adapt to varying content complexity
gaps_limitations.impact: Critical visual details might be omitted in complex scenes with demanding requirements
gaps_limitations.current_approach: Static τ=0.9 and λ=0.011/0.04 parameters across all content types

gaps_limitations.gap: No consideration for dynamic content adaptation during inference
gaps_limitations.impact: Uniform sparsity patterns may not suit varying motion complexity or scene changes
gaps_limitations.current_approach: Offline precomputed masks with no runtime adaptation

gaps_limitations.gap: Limited exploration of multi-GPU or distributed settings
gaps_limitations.impact: Single-GPU constraint limits scalability for ultra-long sequences

gaps_limitations.gap: No explicit handling of temporal consistency in sparse patterns
gaps_limitations.impact: Potential temporal flickering or discontinuities in generated videos
gaps_limitations.current_approach: Independent frame grouping without explicit temporal smoothing

gaps_limitations.gap: Limited analysis of different video genres or content types
gaps_limitations.impact: Patterns may not generalize well to diverse video domains (animation, sports, etc.)
gaps_limitations.current_approach: General T2V evaluation without domain-specific analysis
